parameters.subject: ={{ 'Application invitation for ' + $json.roleTitle }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

Hello ' + $json.candidate.name + ',

You are invited to apply for ' + $json.roleTitle + '.

Please use the link below to upload your resume and complete your application:

Open your application

This link is personal, can be used once, and expires automatically' + ($json.expiresAt ? ' on ' + $json.expiresAt : '') + '.

Regards,
McLink Recruitment Team

' }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, invitationId: $('Validate Invitation Details').item.json.invitationId, recipient: $('Validate Invitation Details').item.json.candidate.email }) }}
